title: candy-code.v1
description: The candy-code server protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0 over the `candy-code.v1` WebSocket subprotocol. `methods` holds each request's params and result; `events` holds the data of each `event` notification, whose params are `$defs/EventEnvelope`. Generated by scripts/gen-protocol-schema.php from src/Protocol — do not edit.
